title: GPTAraEval: A Comprehensive Evaluation of ChatGPT on Arabic NLP

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model performance (using metrics like Macro-F1 and BLEU) on tasks involving Modern Standard Arabic (MSA) versus Dialectal Arabic (DA), as well as analyzing performance disparities across specific regional dialects (e.g., Egyptian, Jordanian, Palestinian, Syrian, and Tunisian). The study also evaluates false-positive toxicity rates, hypothesizing they are driven by the underrepresentation of diverse Arabic dialects in the training data.
